children: Chief Engineering and Technology Officer Ned Curic says that his company will continue hiring additional engineering staff from different locations in the U.S. and Europe amid a multi-year turnaround effort.

“There’s room for growth; I am hiring,” Curic said on the sidelines of the Paris car show, according to Bloomberg. “This year we will hire multiple hundreds (of) additional engineers in the different locations throughout Europe and (the) United States.”
